bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDSC is native on Ethereum as an M0 hub-side wrapper and is represented on Soneium through M0 Portal V2. The active route unwraps USDSC, transfers M through the Ethereum HubPortal and Soneium SpokePortal over Hyperlane, then rewraps M into Soneium USDSC. Portal roles, local representation upgrades, adapter peers/operators, Hyperlane Mailbox validation, and the unresolved default-ISM validator domain are assessed here rather than in Mint Authority.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex mint-bridge boundary migration; verified finding 2026-08-16

protocols.name: M0 Portal V2
protocols.note: HubPortal locks/releases canonical M while SpokePortal burns/mints the spoke M representation; USDSC is unwrapped before transfer and rewrapped after receipt.

protocols.name: Hyperlane
protocols.note: The active Portal adapter uses Hyperlane Mailbox peers; the Soneium Mailbox selects a live default ISM for inbound validation.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum is the canonical M0 hub-side USDSC deployment. The verified MExtension mints USDSC only after Ethereum SwapFacility transfers matching M into the extension; the M0 Portal V2 cross-chain route unwraps this native wrapper before transfer and rewraps the destination representation.

routes.protocol: M0 Portal V2 with Hyperlane adapter
routes.reviewNote: Soneium USDSC is a spoke representation. M0 SpokePortal burns and mints the Soneium M representation, while the local SwapFacility rewraps that M into USDSC. The active adapter peer, Portal path, and supported USDSC route were verified in both directions.

controls.label: Soneium USDSC representation wrapper
controls.capDescription: The Soneium MExtension wraps the Soneium M representation after the Portal receive path and burns USDSC on unwrap; it does not create base M independently. Route supply is bounded by the M representation transferred through the Portal path.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Soneium SwapFacility unwraps the source extension before Portal transfer and rewraps the destination extension after M arrives; the wrapper remains 1:1 against M.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: At Soneium block 26895895, USDSC total supply was 4,780,250.278387 and its M balance was 4,780,286.560938, an accrued excess of 36.282551 M; the local wrapper does not independently create base M supply.

controls.evidence: At Soneium block 26895895, the USDSC proxy resolved to implementation 0x38e4713a896efcf253430efd6292515dc13489a1, bound to the same M token and SwapFacility constructor addresses. Its M balance exceeded USDSC supply by 36.282551 M. This local wrapper is retained as bridge-route machinery because Soneium M is a Portal-minted representation of canonical M.
